integrity: Theorems derive from explicit frozen-path generating functions and renewal-reward arguments; finite symbolic checks are only supplementary. Novelty has not received independent priority validation.
scientific_limitations: Only i.i.d. deterministic arrows on Z with global geometric refresh; annealed results for 0<a<1 and 0<p<=1. No uniqueness of biased optimum, no partial refresh or general environment classification.
title: Exact transport and a sharp diffusivity phase boundary for refreshed arrow walks
